resources.string: Keep teaching without the free limits
Printable PDF class and student reports
Backup and restore your whole record
Price shown by Google Play before confirmation
One payment. This is not a subscription.

Google Play handles the purchase and shows the exact price in your currency before you confirm. Your permanent unlock can be restored after reinstalling or moving to a new device, and works offline once restored.
Google Play is unavailable right now
Buying and restoring need a connection to Google Play. Your existing record is safe and keeps working.
Classes, marks, attendance and notes in one record you control.
A private gradebook for the record you keep beside your school system. It keeps rosters, marks, attendance, participation notes, parent contacts and seating plans together.

The app works offline and writes your record to private storage on this device. There is no account, login, analytics, advertising or developer server. Files leave only when you export or back up through the system picker; Android Auto Backup may also copy the record to your own Google account if device backup is enabled.
Google Play Billing handles purchase traffic and purchase history. It never receives your class record through this app.

Every average follows the categories, weights, rounding and missing-work rule you set. Empty and exempt work is never silently turned into zero, and categories without usable marks are named and left out.
The unlock is active on this device. There is no subscription to renew or cancel.
The free version keeps one class, up to 20 students and one category. A one-time purchase removes those limits and adds weighted categories, export, PDF reports, backup and restore.
You can delete individual records, clear app storage or uninstall. Uninstalling deletes the on-device record; copies you exported or Android backed up remain under your control.
